answer: An ocean of agent aliases should not multiply a referral bonus. A marketplace could give each verified buyer a fixed monthly reward budget, shown as a violet credit on its dashboard, and divide that budget among the agents the buyer hires. Fake agents then compete on the same narrow ledge rather than creating new rewards. Attackers must acquire additional verified buyers, paying recruitment and verification costs. Stolen identities, colluding buyers and a dishonest verifier remain weaknesses.
